entries.name: Seamoretech first seed closing
entries.what: Seamoretech, a Porto-based CleanTech company that turns salty waste water from desalination plants into fresh water and minerals, raised EUR 1.1 million in the first closing of its seed round, from Rypples, 7Seas Capital and Crédito Agrícola. The article says the money supports technology development, market expansion and the recovery of critical raw materials.
